column1: # Consolidated CMSketch and estimator original-test evidence.

column8: note
Every declared test and generated/subtest obligation in the file is mapped below through the canonical state family.

Go-compatible seeded RNG and Zipf generation reproduce seeds 0 and 1, 100000 rows, imax 1000000, factors 1.1/2/3, integer EncodeValue/query, both pre-merge bounds, and strict doubled post-merge bounds.
The 5x2048 MaxUint32 sketch produces the exact 61457-byte tipb layout and round-trips counters, count, dimensions, and default value.
The exact seed-0 million-row Zipf streams, first-1000 encoded samples, four factors, TopN size bound, and source average-error limits are exercised.
All valid generated values and all invalid runtime intest assertions preserve exact results and panic payloads.
All three named generated cases preserve exact source inputs and outputs.
All three invalid boundaries panic with the exact assert failed payload under runtime-enabled internal checks.
The first 1000 integer EncodeValue samples build a no-TopN sketch for one million unique rows; NDV, scale, default value, and all one million integer queries are exact.

MaxUint32 counters, exact wire length, twenty 20000-byte MaxUint64 TopN rows, nil/empty CMS distinctions, external-row TopN sorting, embedded TopN round trips, and exact small generated-proto vectors are covered.
TopN metadata sorts count-descending with deterministic encoded-byte tie ordering.
All six source factors scale twenty nonuniform counts through the u64 truncation boundary and remain below the 0.0001 aggregate rounding-error ratio.
Every declared global-singleton case is mapped below, including exact integer Datum hashing for the regression fixture and exact runtime assertion payloads.
The complete source table exercises copied merges, half ranges, exact/disjoint/overlap cases, negative clamp, nil entries, empty input, and mismatched lengths.
The exact three-node a-through-f example returns four.
One node contributes all three local singletons.
Three disjoint two-value nodes contribute six.
Two fully overlapping nodes contribute zero.
The exact node samples 0 and 0/0/0/1/1/4/7 traverse integer EncodeValue and Murmur3 into max-size-3 sketches and preserve the per-node clamp result two.
Both nil positions panic with their exact source assertion payloads.
Empty inputs panic with the exact source assertion payload while release defensive return remains present when checks are disabled.
Mismatched lengths panic with the exact source assertion payload while release defensive return remains present when checks are disabled.
